answer: Hide which answers are being graded together. Each grader receives a batch that mixes the answer it must judge with decoys it cannot tell apart, and only the real one counts. A sybil ring that wants to boost a member cannot find that member in the batch, because every entry is shown as a plain cipher with no author attached. Over many epochs the network builds an atlas of each grader record, and honest ones stand firm like cedar while ring members that guess and boost blindly fall out of trust.
